fact: An unknown identity, ambiguous record, unverifiable version or missing operation capability leaves a write pending.
An owner-isolated create supplies owner, fact_id, fact_version, an idempotency key and null if_version. Retrying a create must preserve retirement.
Conditional updates target the remote ID, require conditional_update, and carry the expected remote version and owner with the local fact version.
Retirement requires conditional_forget, explicit local retirement authorization, and owner- and version-guarded readback of a retired record.
Before each write, sync rechecks the approved local snapshot. It verifies the returned record against owner-scoped readback and confirms an already matching remote version without another write.
